tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: $0.005 per call — Fetch a public URL and return status, final URL, title, cleaned text (scripts/styles stripped, truncated) and the top 20 absolute links. Useful when an agent itself cannot reach the open web.

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: $0.005 per call — Domain due-diligence bundle: RDAP registrar + creation/expiry dates + status, DNS records (A/MX/NS/TXT), and Certificate Transparency history via crt.sh. Use to vet a domain before trusting or linking to it.

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: $0.005 per call — GitHub repo snapshot: stars, forks, open-issue count, watchers, primary language, SPDX license, created/pushed dates and latest release tag. Use to triage a repo before contributing or depending on it.

tools.name: token_intel
tools.description: $0.005 per call — Base ERC-20 due-diligence: on-chain name, symbol, decimals and total supply via eth_call. Use to sanity-check a Base token address before interacting with it.

tools.name: repo_diligence
tools.description: $0.03 per call — Deep GitHub repo due-diligence: base snapshot + last 5 commits (author/date/message), contributor count, archived flag, security-policy presence, latest release cadence and open/closed issue ratio. Use to decide whether to depend on or contribute to a repo before trusting it.

tools.name: web_brief
tools.description: $0.02 per call — Multi-source research brief from 1–3 URLs. For each source extract title, meta description, key sentences (numbered/quoted/date-or-figure-bearing) and outbound links. Returns a structured, citable brief other agents can consume without their own web access.

tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: $0.01 per call — Real-time stock quotes: price, change, change percent, open, high, low, volume, turnover, currency and exchange timestamp. Covers A-shares (sh600000, sz000001), Hong Kong (hk00700) and US (usAAPL or plain AAPL). Accepts several symbols at once separated by commas. No API key needed,

tools.name: free_url_check
tools.description: FREE — FREE: check whether a public URL is reachable and what it is. Returns HTTP status, final URL after redirects, content type and page title. Use web_fetch (paid) for full text and links.

tools.name: usgs_earthquakes
tools.description: $0.002 per call — Recent earthquakes from the USGS GeoJSON feed (no API key). Returns magnitude, place, time, depth and coordinates for each event. Params: period = hour|day|week (default day); minmag = minimum magnitude (default 0); limit = max events (default 20).

tools.name: open_meteo_weather
tools.description: $0.002 per call — Current weather from Open-Meteo (no API key, no signup). Given lat/lon returns temperature (C), apparent temperature, humidity, wind speed, precipitation and a WMO weather code. Params: lat, lon (required).

tools.name: exchange_rates
tools.description: $0.002 per call — Live fiat exchange rates (open.er-api.com, no key, ~200 currencies). Params: base = ISO code (default USD); to = comma list or single code (default EUR,GBP,JPY,CNY). Returns rates and the last-update timestamp.

tools.name: sec_edgar_search
tools.description: $0.02 per call — SEC EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov, no key). Find filings by term. Params: q = search term (required); forms = comma list e.g. 10-K,8-K; limit = max hits (default 10). Returns filing date, company, CIK and accession number for each hit.

tools.name: fda_recalls
tools.description: $0.02 per call — FDA recall enforcement reports from open.fda.gov (no key, rate-limited). Params: type = food|drug|device (default food); reason = free-text filter; limit = max records (default 10). Returns recall reason, status, date and product description for each match.
